### Bible Pathways - February 2, 2006
Author: Bible Pathways
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-february-2-2006-1375716.html
Passage: Leviticus 6:14-17
Points:
- The grain offering acted as tribute offered to God, acknowledging Him as King and sustaining a right relationship with Him.
- Bringing crushed fine flour served as recognition that God provides daily life and sustenance.
- Burning frankincense alongside the offering symbolized prayers and intercession that are pleasing to the Lord.
- While the burnt offering represented personal consecration, the grain offering represented the dedication of daily service.
- The crushed grain points forward to Jesus Christ, who was bruised and suffered to provide atonement for sin.
